name: Being Pure
overview: Scripture reveals that being pure involves a heart renewed and cleansed by God, as David prays for a clean heart and a right spirit within (Psalms 51:10). Purity is reflected in the words of the Lord, described as refined and flawless like silver purified multiple times (Psalms 12:6). Jesus teaches that the pure in heart are blessed and will see God (Matthew 5:8), while the believer’s thoughts should focus on what is true, honest, just, pure, and lovely (Philippians 4:8). True purity also includes living honorably in marriage (Hebrews 13:4) and practicing undefiled religion by caring for the vulnerable and remaining unstained by the world (James 1:27).
